newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 1.0 lower at 1,017.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 1.0 lower at 1,017.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 1.0 lower at 1,017.00 as a mostly speculative demand for U.S. currency helped knock it off its intraday high of 1,014.90, interbank dealers said.
They said there was no real demand for dollars from the corporate sector, but sporadic buying of greenbacks by banks and other financial entities put downward pressure on the peso.
Dealers reported 317 trades for a total of $118 million and said the peso hit a low of 1,019.85 before strengthening ahead of the close.
